description.value: Grub Shack Allenby is a casual fast-food spot on Allenby Road in Duncan serving burgers, sandwiches, and diner-style fare. The name and cuisine mix suggest a laid-back, unfussy eatery well suited to a hungry cyclist looking for a quick, filling meal. It sits in the Duncan area of the Cowichan Valley, a popular cycling corridor on southern Vancouver Island.
